description: Rewrites the whole flake.lock. This is the ONLY mechanism that moves our
inputs: Renovate's per-input nix updates use the git-refs datasource,
which needs a versioned ref to bump, and all eight inputs track branches
(nixpkgs-unstable, nixos-unstable, or a default branch). With no tags
there is no version to propose — only the locked rev moves, and that is
this. Splitting cheap inputs from nixpkgs is therefore not possible
without repinning inputs to tags, which we do not want for unstable.
Automerges behind the three required status checks on main, which include
a native build of all four host closures. Measured cost of a real nixpkgs
bump: 42 min on rivendell's aarch64 runner, 13s on orthanc. Twice weekly
caps that at ~84 min/week on a host that is also serving Caddy, HA, DNS
and ntfy while it builds.
Per-input flake updates. Inert today — see the lockFileMaintenance note
above — but kept aligned with it so that pinning any single input to a
tag later starts producing PRs on the same schedule and gate rather
than silently on Renovate's defaults.
These used to be held back from automerge 'to catch Caddy plugin hash
changes'. That reason is gone: pre-build compiles caddy.withPlugins as
part of rivendell's toplevel and fails loudly on a mismatch, and as of
PR #609 that job is a REQUIRED check rather than an advisory one. The
gate always caught it; it just was not allowed to block.
